title: HUD Fair Market Rents
verified_findings: Area-based 40th-percentile gross rent benchmarks. FY2026 original and revised county files and revised ZIP/area file obtained.
limits: Not asking rents, luxury rents, property listings or exact utility tariffs. ZIP plus HUD area is the row key; ZIP alone is not unique.

title: HDB resale transactions
verified_findings: Transactions provide month, town, block/street, storey range, flat type, floor area, lease information and SGD price.
limits: No unit number, exact floor, bedroom count, bathroom count, private condo coverage or current availability. A 4 ROOM flat is not a four-bedroom assertion.

title: Singapore Open Data Licence
verified_findings: Dataset landing page identifies open reuse for personal and commercial purposes.
limits: Preserve source attribution and dataset version; no endorsement implied.

title: French property transactions
verified_findings: Transaction data derived from notarial and cadastral information. Geographic exclusions include Alsace, Moselle and Mayotte. Updates can revise prior years.
limits: No re-identification of people or external search-engine indexing of personal data. Not current listing availability.

title: Geocoded DVF
verified_findings: Geocoded data provided under Open Licence 2.0. Downloaded 2025 nationwide CSV archive from official files server.
limits: Multiple rows can describe one mutation; price must not be attributed repeatedly to individual parcels/units.

title: HM Land Registry Price Paid Data
verified_findings: Completed registered property sale records, with updates and corrections.
limits: OGL does not blanket-license third-party address rights. Game redistribution of addresses is not automatically cleared. Not included as a bulk dataset here.

title: UK private rents October 2026 release
verified_findings: September provisional monthly private rent: UK GBP1406, England1466, Wales848, Scotland1011. Published 21 October2026.
limits: Population averages, not offers for individual homes. Cross-country collection differences and subsequent revisions matter.

title: Overture addresses
verified_findings: Address data is assembled from many contributing sources; monthly releases, no stable address matcher at retrieval.
limits: No rent, tenure, interior, condition, listings, or guarantee of worldwide completeness. Not downloaded in this package.

title: Overture attribution
verified_findings: Address source licences differ; building theme uses ODbL.
limits: Do not flatten all themes to one permissive licence; preserve contributor attribution and database obligations.

title: Private rental deposits
verified_findings: Deposit cap: five weeks below GBP50000 annual rent, six at or above; holding deposit up to one week.
limits: Not a UK-wide or every-accommodation cap; tenancy scope and effective version required.

title: Tenancy deposit protection
verified_findings: Protection within30 days; return within10 days after both sides agree the refund.
limits: Disputed refunds do not share the same immediate payout path; Scotland and Northern Ireland have separate schemes.

title: Private rental repairs
verified_findings: Landlord responsibilities include structure, heating/hot water and wiring; tenant-caused damage is distinct.
limits: Do not auto-charge tenants for every equipment or fabric failure.

title: Building regulations approval
verified_findings: Building-control approval and planning permission are distinct; construction, extensions and specified alterations can require approval.
limits: Local/project applicability, competent-person exceptions and higher-risk building route are separate. Not a universal permit fee or lead time.

title: Nationally described space standard
scope: England where the planning standard applies
verified_findings: 1bed1person single-storey39m2, or37m2 with shower room; 1bed2person50m2; single bedroom at least7.5m2 and2.15m wide.
limits: Planning standard, not worldwide minimum nor automatic national building regulation. Existing dwellings are not retroactively invalidated.

title: Space standard status
verified_findings: Standard remains in planning system and is not a building regulation.
limits: Must establish local adoption before enforcing.

title: Loan Estimate
verified_findings: Estimate normally due within3 business days of application; includes rate, payment and closing-cost information.
limits: Not a guaranteed lender approval or universal loan term; no live mortgage quotes obtained.

title: Loan Estimate components
verified_findings: Separate principal/interest, mortgage insurance, escrow items and cash to close.
limits: Do not count financed principal as player earnings or count escrow payments twice. Tax engine remains out of game scope.

title: NYC permit exemptions
verified_findings: Some painting, cabinet, floor resurfacing and ordinary repair work is permit-exempt; other compliance and licensed-trade requirements remain.
limits: Not exemption from landlord/condo permission, all plumbing licensing, or building rules.

title: Foreign ownership
verified_findings: Foreign purchase of landed residential property requires approval; condominium units have a different approval route. Approximate complete-application assessment30 working days.
limits: HDB eligibility is separate. Thirty days is an estimate, not approval entitlement or guarantee.

title: HDB renovation controls
verified_findings: Use registered renovation contractors; wall demolition needs prior written approval. General work09:00–18:00 weekdays/Saturdays; restricted noisy work09:00–17:00 weekdays with holiday/eve exclusions.
limits: Not all Singapore housing. Flat-specific requirements and detailed guidelines also apply; this profile is not complete.

title: HDB building works
verified_findings: Replacing specified tile/stone finishes requires approval; laying vinyl/carpet/linoleum is listed without permit. Total applicable screed/finish limit50mm.
limits: Different from timber overlay rules. No automatic approval to hack structural elements or install a pool.

title: Queensland rental bonds
scope: Queensland ordinary tenancies and listed accommodation
verified_findings: General/rooming bond up to4 weeks; moveable dwelling2 weeks, or3 with electricity; lodgement within10 days.
limits: Employer accommodation can differ; not all Australia. Bond amount remains separate from rent.

title: Tenant changes
verified_findings: Written requests for minor changes; response normally within21 days. Minor qualifying changes cannot be unreasonably refused; restoration may be required.
limits: Major structural renovations are a different path; the legal definition of minor must be tested.

title: Ontario standard lease guidance
verified_findings: Rent deposit is for final rental period, capped at lesser of one month or one rental period; annual interest; refundable key deposit is distinct.
limits: Not security for property damage and not a Canada-wide rule.

title: French residential rental deposits
verified_findings: Typical monthly-payment deposit caps: unfurnished1 month base rent, furnished2; mobility lease no deposit; quarterly-in-advance exception.
limits: Charges excluded; agreement and payment frequency matter. Not all commercial/holiday leases.

title: BGB551
verified_findings: Maximum3 monthly base rents excluding operating costs; cash security can be paid in3 equal monthly instalments; keep funds separate, earnings accrue to tenant.
limits: Student/youth accommodation interest exception; do not generalize to commercial leases.

title: Brazil Lei8245 articles37–38
verified_findings: Cash security maximum3 months rent; savings deposit benefits tenant; cannot demand multiple statutory guarantee modalities in one lease.
limits: Cash security is one guarantee choice, not mandatory for every agreement.

title: MLIT restoration guidance
verified_findings: Move-in/out condition records distinguish pre-existing damage, ordinary aging and tenant-caused damage. Ordinary wear generally differs from tenant liability, subject to valid terms.
limits: Not a fixed deposit, key-money or renovation-fee schedule.

title: Dubai Land Department FAQ
verified_findings: Index distinguishes new lease indication from renewal disputes; uses contract and market details.
limits: Not a universal UAE rent multiplier. No live Ejari or individual quote obtained.

title: Cape Town minor works
verified_findings: Pools need building-plan approval even on private land; some small nonstructural works are exempt.
limits: Not all South Africa or all Africa. Owning a yard is not permit approval.

title: Cape Town planning sequence
verified_findings: Land-use requirements can precede building plans; technical review includes services, safety and heritage where applicable.
limits: No invented municipal price/processing duration.

title: Mexico restricted-zone trusts
verified_findings: Foreign direct land ownership restricted within100km of borders and50km of coast; trust route can permit use/enjoyment for up to50years.
limits: Need parcel location and applicable legal structure; no blanket citizen-style freehold flag.

title: Kenya Constitution Article65
verified_findings: Noncitizens may hold land only on leasehold, term no longer than99years.
limits: Property ownership does not create immigration or work permission.

title: Thailand foreign condo ownership
verified_findings: Official fee page describes49percent total space; another official procedure page describes49percent units.
limits: Conflicting wording: do not implement denominator from these summaries. Obtain controlling law before activating this rule.

title: 2024 construction cost survey
verified_findings: Reported average construction USD428215, finished area2647sqft, finished lot91057; total sale price665298.
limits: Survey average, not local contractor quote, universal cost-per-area rate or apartment renovation price.

title: EIA2025 state electricity averages
verified_findings: 2025 annual electricity average-price table downloaded.
limits: Average revenue per sold kWh, not customer tariff. Must not add fixed delivery charges again as if this were energy-only.

title: EIA average price methodology
verified_findings: Average prices derived from revenue divided by sales and include delivered-electricity costs.
limits: Not a time-of-use tariff or any individual utility bill.

title: EPA data licence
verified_findings: Default domestic public-domain status; evaluate dataset metadata and limitations.
limits: Brand trademarks, logos and photos are not licensed simply because model facts are available.

title: ENERGY STAR Residential Refrigerators
verified_findings: Downloaded model-level certification and technical fields; raw per-model records included.
limits: Not all products, local stock or prices. Model-family wildcards are not individual SKUs; rated test energy is not actual household consumption.

title: ENERGY STAR Residential Clothes Washers
verified_findings: Downloaded model-level certification and technical fields; raw per-model records included.
limits: Not all products, local stock or prices. Model-family wildcards are not individual SKUs; rated test energy is not actual household consumption.

title: ENERGY STAR Residential Clothes Dryers
verified_findings: Downloaded model-level certification and technical fields; raw per-model records included.
limits: Not all products, local stock or prices. Model-family wildcards are not individual SKUs; rated test energy is not actual household consumption.

title: ENERGY STAR Residential Dishwashers
verified_findings: Downloaded model-level certification and technical fields; raw per-model records included.
limits: Not all products, local stock or prices. Model-family wildcards are not individual SKUs; rated test energy is not actual household consumption.

title: ENERGY STAR Room Air Conditioners
verified_findings: Downloaded model-level certification and technical fields; raw per-model records included.
limits: Not all products, local stock or prices. Model-family wildcards are not individual SKUs; rated test energy is not actual household consumption.

title: EU appliance labels
verified_findings: EPREL provides appliance energy information; revised labels for specified classes useA–G.
limits: Do not equate US certification to EU class. Bulk EPREL models not acquired here.

title: NFIP flood cover
verified_findings: Homeowner building cover up toUSD250000 and contents up to100000; renter contents up to100000. Flood cover differs from most ordinary home/renter policies.
limits: Coverage terms, waiting periods, location and exclusions still govern; these are limits, not premiums.

title: Appliance energy estimation
verified_findings: Energy kWh = watts times operating hours divided by1000; cost uses applicable per-kWh price.
limits: Cycling appliances need actual runtime/duty cycle. Do not assume constant nameplate load.
